mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount),0) FROM orders WHERE table_session_id=#{sessionId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM((order_items.unit_price+order_items.options_amount)*(order_items.quantity-COALESCE(cancelled.quantity,0))),0) FROM order_items INNER JOIN orders ON orders.id=order_items.order_id INNER JOIN menu_items ON menu_items.id=order_items.menu_item_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id,SUM(requested_quantity) quantity FROM order_item_cancellation_requests WHERE status='APPROVED' GROUP BY order_item_id) cancelled ON cancelled.order_item_id=order_items.id WHERE orders.table_session_id=#{sessionId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM promotion_targets WHERE promotion_id=#{promotionId} AND ((target_type='MENU_ITEM' AND target_id=order_items.menu_item_id) OR (target_type='CATEGORY' AND target_id=menu_items.category_id)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_redemptions(store_id,promotion_id,promotion_code_id,client_account_id,table_session_id,payment_id,status) SELECT bill_discounts.store_id,bill_discounts.promotion_id,bill_discounts.promotion_code_id,table_sessions.client_account_id,bill_discounts.table_session_id,bill_discounts.payment_id,'COMPLETED' FROM bill_discounts INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=bill_discounts.table_session_id INNER JOIN promotions ON promotions.id=bill_discounts.promotion_id LEFT JOIN promotion_codes ON promotion_codes.id=bill_discounts.promotion_code_id WHERE bill_discounts.payment_id=#{paymentId} AND (promotions.max_redemptions IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_redemptions r WHERE r.promotion_id=promotions.id AND r.status='COMPLETED') < promotions.max_redemptions) AND (promotion_codes.id IS NULL OR promotion_codes.max_redemptions IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_redemptions r WHERE r.promotion_code_id=promotion_codes.id AND r.status='COMPLETED') < promotion_codes.max_redemptions) AND (promotions.max_redemptions_per_customer IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_redemptions r WHERE r.promotion_id=promotions.id AND r.client_account_id=table_sessions.client_account_id AND r.status='COMPLETED') < promotions.max_redemptions_per_customer)
